sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Imposter Smashers are simple yet addictive. Players take on the role of an imposter, who must smash other players to become bigger and stronger. The game is played in real-time, with players competing against each other in a free-for-all format.

The game controls are easy to learn, with players using their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to move around the map and smash other players. The game also offers a variety of power-ups and special abilities that can be used to gain an edge over other players.

One of the key features of Imposter Smashers is its auto-matchmaking system, which ensures that players are matched with opponents of similar skill levels. This makes it easier for players to compete against each other and enjoy a more balanced gaming experience.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Imposter Smashers are engaging and fun, making it a great game for players of all ages and skill levels.
